goal: Stop periodic wallet rebroadcasts from re-announcing transactions already resident in the local mempool
Prevents leaking user IP and transaction ownership to connected peers
agreement: Support for the privacy fix, but an objection remains unanswered
Strong support because it is an obvious privacy improvement (murchandamus)
Unaddressed objection: attackers can still probe addresses, leaving receiver privacy leak open (mzumsande)
Verified rebroadcast suppression on regtest and suggested extending test coverage (fametrano)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes a privacy leak that reveals wallet ownership and user IP to peers
Redundant rebroadcasts signal to peers that the node has a special interest in unconfirmed transactions
